description: One context request to one result. CLI resolves project/service and observes facts. Daemon identity_gate verifies facts and owns identity selection, creation, recovery, registration through the existing host transaction, default lease and full project snapshot. Identity recovery is the anchor ladder in docs/design/collab-anchor-restore-model.md: a caller presenting one designed anchor is resolvable with no further fields (tmux owned pane, dsh session anchor, or a complete AppServer observation set), matched against a persisted anchor value with no liveness probe, runtime state or generation requirement; a no-match anchor drafts a new identity; ambiguity or a cross-project match falls to explicit user adjudication, and an adjudication is terminal. Missing facts and explicit failures are invocation-local result terminals inside this stage; no pending workflow. A --provide supplement containing only absent session_id/thread_id/endpoint/namespace starts a new invocation, never a backward edge. No worker selection or CLI recovery sequence. Existing authenticated commands retain their admission; host-local bootstrap uses the existing 0600 Unix socket and verifies actual endpoints before mint. Exact schemas, admission, credentials, commit/lost-response and cleanup contracts: docs/design/collab-identity-minimal-interaction.md and docs/design/collab-anchor-restore-model.md. Local env is diagnostic observation only; snapshot strips internal credential receipt.
